title: Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc-package
text: package collection routines calculate "generalized discrimination score", also known "two alternatives forced-choice score" short: "2AFC-score". 2AFC generic forecast verification framework can applied following verification contexts: dichotomous, polychotomous (ordinal nominal), continuous, probabilistic, ensemble. comprehensive description 2AFC-score, including equations used package, provided Mason Weigel (2009).

title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
text: master routine calculation Generalized Discrimination Score (aka Two-Alternatives Forced Choice Score - 2AFC) described Paper Mason Weigel (2009). routine requires, input, datasets forecasts corresponding observations, well specification verification context. routine checks whether input data consistent verification context, calls appropriate function calculate 2AFC, finally returns 2AFC skill value.

title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
code: afc(obsv, fcst, obsv.type, fcst.type, m = 0, m2 = 0, na.rm = FALSE)

title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
text: obsv Vector observations. required format depends specific verification context. details . fcst Vector two-dimensional array forecasts. required format depends specific verification context. details . obsv.type Character specifying type observations. Possible values: "d" (dichotomous), "m" (polychotomous ordinal categories), "n" (polychotomous nominal categories), "c" (continuous). fcst.type Character specifying type forecasts. Possible values: "d" (dichotomous), "m" (polychotomous ordinal categories), "n" (polychotomous nominal categories), "p" (probabilistic), "c" (continuous) "e" (ensemble). m Number observation forecast categories (required obsv.type fcst.type equals "m" "n") m2 Number forecast categories (required obsv.type fcst.type equal "m"). number observation categories specified argument m . na.rm logical; TRUE pairs obsv fcst NA removed scoring. Default FALSE returns NA input contains NA.

title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
text: p.afc Value Generalized Discrimination Score (2AFC)

title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
text: Depending specific verification context (.e. choice obsv.type fcst.type), routine calls appropriate function(s) calculate 2AFC score. following combinations obsv.type fcst.type possible: (1) "d-d"; (2) "d-m"; (3) "d-p"; (4) "d-c"; (5) "d-e"; (6) "m-m"; (7) "m-p"; (8) "m-c"; (9) "m-e"; (10) "n-n"; (11) "n-p"; (12) "c-c"; (13) "c-e". required format input data obsv fcst depends verification context: (1) "d-d": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values 0,1)fcst: vector length obsv dichotomous forecasts (values 0,1) (2) "d-m": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values 0,1)fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values 1,..,m) (3) "d-p": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values 0,1)fcst: vector length obsv forecast probabilities event happen (4) "d-c": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values 0,1)fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (5) "d-e": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values 0,1)fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size. (6) "m-m": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values 1,..,m)fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values 1,..,m2) (7) "m-p": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values 1,..,m)fcst: two-dimensional array forecast probabilities m categories; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = m (8) "m-c": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values 1,..,m)fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (9) "m-e": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values 1,..,m)fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size. (10) "n-n": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values 1,..,m)fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values 1,..,m) (11) "n-p":  "m-p". (12) "c-c": obsv: vector real-valued observations fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (13) "c-e": obsv: vector real-valued observations fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size.

title: Rank Ensembles — rank.ensembles

title: Rank Ensembles — rank.ensembles
text: routine ranks set ensemble forecasts according "value". higher "value" ensemble forecasts, higher rank. following principle applied: Assume two ensembles B ranked.
